_comment: US-778. Serious+critical axe node counts per authenticated route, measured 2026-09-03 after the primary-colour darkening and four accessible-name fixes. Zero critical violations remain anywhere. What is left is entirely colour-contrast on the FOOD-CATEGORY badge palette (greens, reds and ambers defined per category, e.g. white on #5abc7d at 2.31:1), which is a separate palette problem from the brand primary and needs its own decision. These numbers may only go DOWN: the assertion is <=, so a fix tightens the gate automatically. Regenerate deliberately, never to turn a red run green.
